description: An @observe function that calls @observe(as_type=tool) and then one OpenAI drop-in chat completion.
notes: Langfuse 5.1.0 exports to {base_url}/api/public/otel/v1/traces. base_url is the receiver origin. LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY is capture-public-key and LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY is capture-secret-key. LANGFUSE_MEDIA_UPLOAD_ENABLED is false. LANGFUSE_OBSERVE_DECORATOR_IO_CAPTURE_ENABLED is true, which is also the default, so decorator arguments and return values are recorded on the spans. LANGFUSE_OTEL_COMPRESSION is none and the client also passes otel_compression none, because the receiver rejects a non-identity content encoding and the SDK default is gzip. There is no separate anonymous-telemetry switch in 5.1.0. The client installs its own tracer provider, so the scenario does not call harness.setup. Three spans on scope langfuse-sdk 5.1.0: answer-weather (type span), lookup_weather (type tool), and OpenAI-generation. Decorator input is a JSON object of args and kwargs, and the return value is a raw string. A non-streaming drop-in call does not set completion_start_time. usage_details copies the provider usage object: prompt_tokens 24, completion_tokens 12, total_tokens 36, prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens 8, and completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens 3. model.parameters records the SDK defaults, and max_tokens is the string Infinity.
